module.purpose: Defines the public user profile page, rendering profile information and the user's available event types for direct or embedded access.
module.summary: This client-side React page consumes server-provided user, profile, event type, and publication data. It applies theme and embed configuration, conditionally displays unpublished messaging, renders sanitized biography content and verification badges, and creates links for each public event type while notifying the embed action manager of selections.
module.businessContext: This is the public-facing scheduling profile for users and organizations. If it fails, visitors cannot view availability offerings or navigate to booking pages.
classes: PageProps (~L24): Server-derived properties required to render the public user profile page
functions: UserPage (~L25-152): Renders profile details, event types, embed styling, and publication states

sectionMap.name: profile initialization
sectionMap.intent: Extracts server data and derives theme, embed, query, and display state.

sectionMap.name: unpublished profile branch
sectionMap.intent: Replaces profile content with an unpublished-entity notice when required.

sectionMap.name: profile header rendering
sectionMap.intent: Displays avatar, name, verification badge, and non-empty biography.

sectionMap.name: event type list
sectionMap.intent: Iterates through event types and renders navigation links for booking.

sectionMap.name: event selection notification
sectionMap.intent: Notifies the embed SDK when a visitor selects an event type.

sectionMap.name: empty event list fallback
sectionMap.intent: Shows an empty-state page when no event types are available.

edgeCases.behavior: Returns an unpublished-entity view before rendering profile or event data.
Renders the empty-state component instead of an event link list.

edgeCases.inputShape: Missing or effectively empty user biography
edgeCases.behavior: Omits the biography container when bio is absent or contains only the recognized empty paragraph.
Centers the embedded profile and applies embed-specific sizing and styles.
Displays the organization-colored verification badge instead of the user badge.

boundaryConditions.intent: Centers embedded content unless the embed alignment configuration is explicitly left.
Identifies when no event types are available for the empty-state fallback.

invariants.description: The users collection is expected to contain a first user because the page destructures users[0].
Each event type rendered in the list must provide id, slug, title, and description-compatible data.
The profile username is used to construct every event type destination path.
Event types are rendered in the order supplied by eventTypes.

assumptions.description: The server-side props provide a non-empty users array with a user compatible with the selected profile.
safeBio is assumed to contain sanitized HTML suitable for dangerouslySetInnerHTML.
The embed SDK action manager, when present, accepts eventTypeSelected events containing the complete event type object.

ambiguities.question: Does the server contract guarantee that users always contains at least one element?
ambiguities.affects: UserPage runtime safety and PageProps schema

concurrencyModel.notes: Rendering is synchronous, while event link selection invokes an asynchronous callback that fires an optional embed SDK action.

moduleContractTests.scenario: An entity marked as unpublished is provided.
moduleContractTests.then: the rendered output contains <UnpublishedEntity {...entity} /> and does not render the event-type list
moduleContractTests.rationale: Unpublished entities must not expose public event types.

moduleContractTests.scenario: A public user has no event types.
moduleContractTests.rationale: Empty public profiles require an explicit empty-state message.

moduleContractTests.scenario: A visitor clicks an event-type link.
moduleContractTests.rationale: Embed consumers rely on eventTypeSelected telemetry when booking options are selected.
